World city names and coordinates: GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/) via lutangar/cities.json 1.1.65 (https://github.com/lutangar/cities.json), CC BY 4.0. Modified for Salati: compact country files, coordinates rounded to four decimal places, duplicate removal and legacy city references. Country names/codes: i18n-iso-countries 7.14.0, MIT (https://github.com/michaelwittig/node-i18n-iso-countries). No invented city coordinates.
